| **Thai House** | 456 W Madison St, Chicago, IL 60661 | 素青木瓜沙拉、素綠咖哩、素炸春捲 | (312) 555‑0234 |
| **Bangkok Bistro** | 789 S Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60605 | 素紅咖哩、素烤茄子、素蘿蔔餅 | (312) 555‑0456 |
